request.message:
Update this standing weekly production digest to Week 6. This is the same document every week - edit it in place. Make exactly the changes below and nothing else. STEP 1 - STATUS LINE. The bold status line directly under the document title must read exactly: Week 6 · 2026-02-09 to 2026-02-15 · Phase: Pre-production Leave the smaller grey line beneath it unchanged. STEP 2 - ARCHIVE. The 'Archive' table's data rows must end up being EXACTLY these 5 rows, in exactly this order, top to bottom. Keep the table's header row and all of its formatting. Cells shown in quotes are literal - copy them exactly. Cells shown in angle brackets are for you to write. The rows, top to bottom, must be exactly: 'Week 5', 'Week 4', 'Week 3', 'Week 2', 'Week 1'. Row 'Week 5' is NEW. Its Dates cell is '2026-02-02 to 2026-02-08'. Its Shipped cell is your own summary, at most 20 words, of the bullets currently under 'What changed'. Its Risks carried cell is your own summary, at most 15 words, of the rows currently in the 'What is at risk' table. Every other row keeps its existing cell contents exactly as they are - do not rewrite, reword or re-summarise them. STEP 3 - 'What changed'. Replace the ENTIRE
    element in that section with exactly this HTML, character for character:
    • Engine upgrade to 5.4 merged; build times down 31%
    • Art style exploration narrowed to two directions
    • Nav-mesh generation for the Drift Belt sector
    • First pass on the Salvage economy spreadsheet
    STEP 4 - 'What is at risk' table. Replace the ENTIRE contents of that table's with exactly these 2 rows, character for character. Keep the header row exactly as it is: Boss encounter difficulty untuned for controllerAna F.DesignLowsteadySave-game format still unversionedDev H.EngineeringLowsteady (Context only, do not put this in the document: risks closed this week and therefore absent from the rows above: Outsourced character art slipping two weeks.) STEP 5 - 'What is next'. Replace the ENTIRE
      element in that section with exactly this HTML, character for character:
      • Lock the art direction to one of the two candidates
      • Scope the vertical slice level list
      • Stand up the automated build farm
      REPLACEMENT MEANS REPLACEMENT: where this instruction lists what a section must contain, the section must end up containing exactly that and nothing else. Delete what is not on the list rather than keeping it alongside. Preserve all existing formatting exactly: the document title, every section heading, table borders, header-row shading, alternating row colours, fonts, font sizes and colours. Do not restyle anything. Do not add, remove or rename any heading. Do not reorder the sections. Copy every quoted or listed value character for character. Do not add a full stop to a bullet that has none, and do not reword anything. STRUCTURAL RULE: both tables must remain elements with their header rows intact. Never replace a table with a single row, a div or a list. Never drop a table's header row.

Vantage Nine Studios · internal · standing document, edited in place every Monday

  • Grapple traversal prototype playable end to end on the test level
